decision: HOLD prospective qualified-summary implementation under the current plan; four-of-four sufficient natural witnesses are not established
generic_findings: Some once-authored candidates exceed the common claim count or claim evidence-union limits while preserving all required content. They are rejected as valid witnesses rather than repaired by dropping core content.
A qualified core can still combine distinct events, and exact joined qualifiers can attach a condition to the wrong event. Valid fields and exact spans alone do not prove semantic adequacy.
An additional explanatory clause can lack source support even if the required core facts are present.
These are failures of locked single attempts. No exhaustive impossibility proof for either representation was performed.
limitations: The same source-only AI fixed criteria, authored witnesses and checked them. This is not an independently blinded semantic adjudication or human review.
Possible means an AI-assessed existence example under the fixed source-only coordinates and criteria. It does not mean the service model can generate it.
Provisional zero-based unit spans precede tokenizer partition; input4096/template fit, output768 fit, actual runtime IDs, 120-second deadline, memory and latency remain unverified.
Four sources represent two related project families, not four independent organizations.
Publisher TLDR is retained but was not promoted to reference truth; no witness is an actual model output or training target.
Old L2 run-input unknown and all prior failed runs, locks and protected assignments remain unchanged.
No representation was proven impossible; unconfirmed cases block the plan gate without licensing retries, source replacement, criteria edits, prompt examples or budget increases.
